text:
anna_support: Hey billing team — Customer BrightBridge (acct: BRITE-9) opened a ticket: invoice INV-2026-0421 shows 8.25% CA sales tax even though their billing profile is in ME and they're tax-exempt (PO on file). Can someone take a look? invoice: https://invoices.example/INV-2026-0421

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0421 created (charge_01F...). :receipt:

olivia_finance: On it. Do we have the PO and the tax-exempt certificate? :thinking:

anna_support: Uploaded tax_exempt_cert.pdf and PO-54321 to the ticket. Customer says card was used but they submitted a PO payment method.

mike_billing: Thanks. I'm seeing tax_calculated = true. But note payment_method_country = CA and billing_address_state = ME. Which address did the invoicer use? Log snippet: 
```
invoice.meta -> {
  billing_profile.state: "ME",
  payment_method.country: "US-CA",
  tax.applied: 0.0825
}
```

raj_engineer: Pinging infra to fetch event logs. There's fallback logic in tax-service that chooses payment_method.country if billing_profile.address is missing. Snippet: 
```
if (!billing_profile.address) {
  jurisdiction = payment_method.country;
} else {
  jurisdiction = billing_profile.address.state;
}
```

olivia_finance: Customer does have billing_profile.address (ME). So the fallback shouldn't have triggered. Hmm.

raj_engineer: I pulled the invoice payload: billing_profile.address was present but `billing_profile.address.country` was null due to an earlier CSV import bug. payment_method.country = 'US-CA' -> tax-provider returned CA rate. Repro steps I used: import billing profile CSV with missing country -> create invoice -> tax applied from payment method.

anna_support: Oof. Customer asks for refund for the tax portion and corrected invoice. Can we issue credit note? :pray:

olivia_finance: Yes. We'll create a credit for the tax line and reissue corrected invoice. Tagging @jordan_csm to confirm customer acceptance for offline credit.

jordan_csm: Customer confirmed they'd accept a net-zero credit and new invoice. Please cc me on the refund note.

mike_billing: I'll create credit note CN-2026-089 and issue corrected INV-2026-0421-v2. Also creating internal task to set tax calculation precedence: prefer `billing_profile.tax_jurisdiction` over `payment_method.country` and add a validation on profile imports. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/452

raj_engineer: I'll backport patch to release branch and add integration test. Deploy planned to prod tomorrow 18:00 PT. Will monitor tax regressions.

olivia_finance: Processing credit now, ETA 1-2 business days. I'll update ticket and customer.

anna_support: Thanks all — marking thread for follow-up. I'll update the customer once CN and new invoice are issued. :white_check_mark:
